versionStatus: Version 3 released February 2023; current AASM educational resources continue to teach Version 3 and the project uses the current online manual plus corrections as the governing scoring source.

erratum.note: The online manual incorporates corrections; some uncorrected print copies may differ.

faq.use: Current clarification layer for Version 3 edge cases; the FAQ clarifies but does not replace the licensed manual.
pediatricClarifications: Infant staging depends on the applicable post-term-age framework.
The current FAQ states there is no age limitation for arousal scoring.
Use of adult respiratory criteria for children age 13 years or older is optional; use the laboratory's authorized AASM-consistent pathway rather than mixing criteria event by event.

bestFor: Current reporting, technical specifications, staging, arousal, cardiac, movement, respiratory, and HSAT scoring rules.
authorityBoundary: This is the controlling scoring-rule source in V3 when a scoring definition, threshold, event rule, montage, technical specification, or required/optional reporting rule is at issue. The current AASM FAQ is a clarification layer; supporting textbooks and older technical guidelines must not override the current online manual, corrections, and applicable FAQ clarification.
copyrightUse: Use section names, rule-location directions, and original summaries only. Do not reproduce proprietary rule wording, tables, schematics, or figures.
